q1.question: Is it free to use?
q1.answer: Yes, Vmito is free for players. Hosts have access to premium features for a small fee.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Vmito ("we", "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you provide when using our platform for finding badminton sessions, connecting with players, and managing tournaments. This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your data.

sections.body:
We may collect the following types of information:
• Account information: name, email, phone number, and profile photo when you register.

• Activity information: your sessions, matches, tournaments, clubs, and interactions on the platform.
• Technical information: IP address, device type, browser, and usage data to improve the service.

• Provide and operate Vmito features.
• Connect you with relevant players, clubs, and tournaments.
• Send notifications about activities, invitations, and service updates.
• Ensure safety and detect or prevent fraud and abuse.
• Analyze and improve the user experience.

• When required by law or a valid request from authorities.
